notes: v0.3.77: VHS/wow-flutter audio fix. The latency watchdog was continuously decimating ~1.5% of playback samples (5ms target + .max(1) floor, no hysteresis) — warping pitch like a warped tape. Replaced with a hysteresis band that only drains on genuine runaway latency (>30ms), in whole frames, down to 15ms. In normal operation it never fires → v0.2.x-clean pitch restored, latency still bounded. Confirmed via multi-agent root-cause audit.
